_comment: 011. Every part names its maker. Two parts from one maker on a machine give the maker's 2-piece bonus; three give the 3-piece bonus as well. A bonus is an additive block with the same keys as a module's grid, plus melee, cooldown (abilities ready that many rounds sooner, never below 1), chain, and the flags unshovable / move_after_attack. Player machines only: enemy loadouts are rolled slot by slot, so a set on one would be an accident, not a design.
